description: This file is a shell script that serves as a test suite for verifying the behavior of Git's diff-tree command, especially in cases involving duplicate tree entries and renames. It includes functions for creating Git trees with duplicate entries, sets up specific test cases, and runs various Git diff commands to ensure correctness and stability.

methods.name: make_tree_entry
methods.description: Creates a tree entry with specific mode and sha1, used for building Git trees in the test setup.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Constructs a Git tree object from multiple entries, using 'make_tree_entry' for each component.
